subject: Replace CHAPTER_MAP number keys with subject keys + prefix stripper
description: Add CHAPTER_SUBJECTS (no chapter numbers) and a _CH_PREFIX regex stripping `Chapter N` plus a separator (pipe, colon, hyphen, en-dash, em-dash -- the document has used pipe and hyphen within four days, F7). _slug() strips then matches. Keep longest-key-first for genuine ties. Order comes from document position (already available at line 999), never from the map.
